## Summary

Describe the problem, the smallest complete change, and the user-visible outcome.

## Scope

- Affected shared capability, skill, Agent role, or specialized workflow:
- Explicitly out of scope:

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results. Include a regression test for behavior changes.

## Public surface

Call out changes to plugin manifests, MCP tools, skill contracts, installation, compatibility, or security posture.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within one clear purpose.
- [ ] Tests, lint, formatting, and type checks pass for the affected paths.
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG are updated when public behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private repository content, machine paths, or generated caches are included.
- [ ] Bugkiller-specific behavior has not been promoted into the shared substrate without a reusable contract.
